radius.$description: Nested corners follow: inner radius = outer radius - padding. Where the engine supports it, corners are continuous (corner-shape: squircle).

hairline.$description: All dividers and borders. Never thicker for decoration.

focus-offset.$description: Gap between a control and its focus ring.

glyph.$description: Status glyph stroke (circle states, dock states) at 16 px.

dragging.$description: Large objects go semi-transparent while they travel.
